name: Unidentified planet
description: A planet in the galaxy that was many parsecs away from Markez Moon. The planet had a pipeline that transported Rhydonium during the Imperial Era. In 3 BBY Wilmon Paak, Saw Gerrera and his Partisans used a a piece of equipment to steal an amount of Rhydonium from the pipeline.
